messages:
ravi: Quick heads up — I want to run a validation sweep for the upcoming driver+fw+kernel bundle. Goal: reduce Xid/ECC spikes. Plan below, feedback?

jordan: +1. Can we scope to affected AZs only? us-west-2a had most XIDs last 30d.

infra-bot: Alert: XID spike detected in us-west-2a — 3.2σ above baseline (last 24h). See metrics: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/3421 :warning:

maya: Proposed smoke test checklist:
- boot + driver load
- nvml sanity (list/gpu info)
- synthetic decode (long sequence, 12h soak)
- stressmem with ECC monitoring
- workload replay of top-3 production traces (90th perc seq len)

ravi: Additions: KV-cache heavy decode path, small-batch latency probe, and GPU eviction stress. Pass criteria (initial):
```
max_xid_per_10k_core_hours = 1
p99_latency_regression <= 5% (vs baseline)
no_kernel_oops for 24h on canary nodes
```
If fail -> immediate rollback.

jordan: Rollout plan:
1) Canary: 1 rack per affected AZ (~24 GPUs) — soak 24h
2) If green -> 25% of capacity across AZs for 48h
3) Full sweep remainder with staged drains
Drain policy: if a node records >2 XIDs within 1h or any kernel oops -> auto-drain and isolate.
Run command example for manual drain:
```
/drain-gpu --node $NODE --reason "fw-upgrade-canary"
```

maria: Telemetry updates required: driver_xid_count (per GPU), kernel_oops parsed into structured tags, ECC_event histogram, attach NVML + dmesg snapshot to incidents. Also capture PCI link errors.

ravi: Region/cost note: ap-southeast-1 can't run full soak due to capacity limits — we'll run simulated workloads there and prioritize longer soaks in us-east/us-west. Need temporary reserved quota for canary expansion (ops-ticket #1234).

maya: Ops TODOs:
1) update smoke harness to include KV-cache tests (I'll own)
2) create canary runbook + rollback checklist (I'll draft)
3) alert runbook for XID regression (I'll own)
4) postmortem template
:raised_hand: assigning (1) and (3) to me.

jordan: Timeline: start Monday 2024-05-06 09:00 UTC. Canary 24h, decision meeting Tue 12:00 UTC. Will invite SRE + ML infra.

ravi: ACK. Uploading initial test matrix and hooks to S3: s3://redwood-infra/fw-validation/1712345678/report.md

maria: small sample failure from the last run (for triage):
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (0001:00:01): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus
[ 1234.567893] kernel: NVRM: GPU 0000:01:00.0: RmInitAdapter failed!
```

jordan: thanks — tagging infra-oncall and eng-runtime to be on standby. :thumbsup:
